replies.author: Javipepe
replies.body:
Looking at my evidence, you clearly run while shifting and then there is a moment where you get hit but you stay unscathed, you died right after though. You were also lagging quite a lot on it, getting teleported back every so often.

I'm going to give you the benefit of the doubt because the sprinting while shifting part could have been a server glitch (most times isn't but oh well), and the antikb part could easily have been lag.

I won't question you anymore and therefore this appeal is accepted and your punishment will be deleted, but if you were indeed hacking please never think of doing it anymore, if you need to re-read our current ruleset it can be fount at https://avicus.net/rules .

Welcome back LJT!
